Hello.
I have 4 functions that plot a graph. I'd like to use shiny so as to put in the ui part a slidebar with the numbers 1,2,3,4 (already done) and then, in the server part I'd like to write something like:
if(number of the sidebar= 1){
apply function 1
}

if(number = 2){
apply function2
}

etc.
And this "apply" has to mean plot the graph that is already plotted with the function.
It looks simple but I don't know how to do it.

IN THE UI PART I HAVE:
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 
  headerPanel("IC50: Half maximal inhibitory concentration "),

  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("variable", "Method:",
                list("1" = "Method1",
                     "2" = "Méthod2",
                     "3" = "Method3",
                     "4" = "Method4")),
    checkboxInput("outliers", "Show outliers", FALSE)
  ),
 
  mainPanel()
))

Thank you very much for any help :)

messages.subject: Re: server part calling functions already constructed.
parts:
YOu mean something like this?

ui.R

library(shiny)

# Define UI for random distribution application 
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Tabsets"),
  
  # Sidebar with controls to select the random distribution type
  # and number of observations to generate. Note the use of the br()
  # element to introduce extra vertical spacing

# Show a tabset that includes a plot, summary, and table view
  # of the generated distribution
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput("plot"))
    )
  )
))

server.R

library(shiny)

# Define server logic for random distribution application
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({          
    if(input$variable == "Method1") {
      plot(rnorm(100))
    } else if(input$variable == "Method2") {
      plot(rnorm(200))
    } else if(input$variable == "Method3") {
      plot(rnorm(200))
    }else if(input$variable == "Method4") {
      plot(rnorm(200))
    }
  })  
})
